notes: Asked on the first user turn, and on later turns only when new_goal fires. Picks tier and lane.
Wording from route-questions-v3, except new_goal, which uses the session-level reading Jang chose on 2026-10-24.

task.instructions: What is the work in the user's latest message about? Judge the subject and purpose of the work in the context of the conversation, not the mechanical action that carries it out.

criteria.code_debugging: Diagnose or fix a failing build, test, crash, error or wrong behaviour
criteria.code_implementation: Write new code or add a feature
criteria.code_refactor: Restructure, rename, clean up or migrate existing code without changing behaviour
criteria.code_review: Review, audit or critique code or a diff
criteria.repo_exploration: Find, read or explain things in a codebase or files
criteria.shell_ops: Run commands, manage files, packages, services, machines or configuration
criteria.web_research: Look up external information, documentation or facts on the web
criteria.writing_creative: Creative prose: fiction, voice, style or other expressive writing
criteria.writing_technical: Technical or practical writing: docs, notes, messages, reports
criteria.planning_design: Plan work, design a system, or decide between approaches
criteria.qa_knowledge: Answer a question from general knowledge without touching files
criteria.agent_coordination: Direct, relay to or manage other agents, models or tools: delegate work, pass on another agent's result, switch or stop an agent
criteria.conversation_feedback: Acknowledge, react, give feedback or status, or chat, without asking for new work

difficulty.instructions: How hard is the action this message asks the agent to take? Judge the action itself, not the stakes or the size of the topic: undoing the previous step is trivial even when the topic is large.

spec_clear.instructions: Is the request explicit and unambiguous about what to produce, leaving no guesswork about requirements?
